acceptance_criteria: While a chosen file is still being read, no 'Speichern' for an earlier picture is shown; a refused later file drops the earlier preview
pictureFromFile refuses an image above 40 megapixels after loading its size and before drawing it, in German ('Das Bild ist zu groß …')
Board tiles (src/board.ts) and caregiver rows use the same rule as the picture view: a src only for isSymbolDataUrl or a bundled ./icons/*.svg path; a test ties every CONCEPTS symbolPath to that rule
A test exports a profile with a symbol.<id> entry and imports it under a new id; the board of the copy shows the same picture

A browser test (test/browser, synthetic images only) runs pictureFromFile in Chromium: an SVG with a script becomes a PNG without running it, a large image is scaled to at most 256 px, a text file and a broken PNG are refused
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: Tighten the picture import that shipped: the view never offers to save a picture that is about to be replaced or that a refused later file superseded, very large images are refused before they are decoded in full, every place that shows a picture accepts only a stored picture or a bundled icon, and the conversion and the backup round trip are covered by tests.
non_goals: Removing pictures of concepts that are off the board
